两肺之间是什么？What sits between your lungs?

在三维中观察一个来自人体参考图谱的胸腔。转动躯干，在体表打开一个观察窗，看清正面平视时容易被遮住的空间关系。

Inspect an atlas-derived human chest in three dimensions. Rotate the torso and open a window in its body surface to see relationships that a flat front view can hide.

01预测排列Predict the arrangement

打开观察窗后，你会看到哪种排列？Which arrangement will the cutaway show?

02看进去Look inside

打开胸腔观察窗，选中心脏，再转到侧面。如果肺挡住了你想看的结构，可以把肺隐藏。

Open the chest inspection window. Select the heart, then turn toward a side view. Hide the lungs if they block the structure you want to inspect.

更多视角选项More viewing options

03解释这个关系Explain the relationship

阅读解剖学解释Read the anatomical explanation

两肺位于胸腔内心脏的两侧。左肺略小，因为心脏在左侧占据了一部分空间。膈肌是位于肺下方的穹顶状肌肉，把胸腔和腹腔分开。

转动或隐藏某个结构只改变你能看到什么，不会把器官移到体内的新位置。

The lungs sit on either side of the heart in the chest. The left lung is slightly smaller because the heart takes up some space on the left. The diaphragm is a dome-shaped muscle below the lungs that separates the chest cavity from the abdominal cavity.

Rotating or hiding a structure changes visibility. It does not move an organ to a new position inside the body.

04迁移到新视角Transfer to a new view

想象从背后看这个躯干。哪个关系仍然成立？Imagine seeing this torso from the back. Which relationship stays true?

来源、改动与边界Sources, changes and limits

几何与改动。体表、肺段、气管支气管树和心脏表面来自 Human Reference Atlas / HuBMAP Visible Human 男性参考模型，采用 CC BY 4.0 许可。固定版本的源模型保留了共同坐标和相对比例。本衍生版把皮肤裁成胸像、降低了网格密度、量化了坐标并更换了显示颜色。躯干裁切处留有可见的开口边界。观察窗只移除体表，不是手术切口。金色膈肌是示意性的穹顶，不是图谱网格。

渲染选择。图谱网格提供有机的解剖形态；原生 WebGL 提供平滑法线和深度测试遮挡。Anatomy 工具包贡献了检视方式，本技能贡献了“预测—检视—解释”的课程结构；Anatomy 工具包并不提供人体器官几何。

范围。这是参考人体的教学视图，不针对具体患者。没有模拟呼吸、血流或临床判断。关系的来源：NHLBI，呼吸系统 · NHLBI，呼吸肌 · NHLBI，心脏解剖。网格已内嵌，可离线使用；来源链接需要联网。

Geometry and changes. Body surface, lung segments, tracheobronchial tree and heart surfaces are derived from the Human Reference Atlas / HuBMAP Visible Human male reference objects, licensed CC BY 4.0. Pinned source models retain their shared coordinates and relative scale. This derivative crops the skin to a bust, reduces mesh density, quantizes coordinates and changes display colors. The torso crop has visible open boundaries. The inspection window removes body surface only; it is not a surgical cut. The gold diaphragm is an illustrative dome, not an atlas mesh.

Rendering choice. Atlas meshes provide the organic anatomy. Native WebGL supplies smooth normals and depth-tested occlusion. Anatomy contributes the inspection approach and the fused skill contributes the predict, inspect and explain lesson; the Anatomy skill does not supply human organ geometry.

Scope. A reference-body teaching view, not patient-specific anatomy. No breathing, blood flow or clinical interpretation is simulated. Sources for the relationships · NHLBI, The respiratory system · NHLBI, Breathing muscles · NHLBI, Heart anatomy. The mesh is embedded and works offline; source links require a connection.

离线可用。所有操作都有原生控件：Tab 切换，方向键调节滑块，空格勾选复选框。Works offline. Every action has a native control: Tab to move, arrow keys on sliders, Space for checkboxes.
